events.what: Wang relates Hodge integrals and the lambda_g conjecture to Virasoro constraints for target varieties
Guo-Zhang prove ancestor and generalized Virasoro conjectures for semisimple CohFTs and the genus-0 part more generally
Guo-Zhang-Zhou prove the genus-1 Virasoro conjecture on the ambient state space of smooth Fano complete intersections
Hu-Jin-Ke-Lu-Tseng-Wu prove Virasoro constraints for relative GW theory of smooth projective effective orbifold curves, giving the Jiang-Tseng orbifold Virasoro conjecture for them

judgement.doubts: The orbifold-curve result concerns the Jiang-Tseng orbifold generalisation; smooth curves were already known pre-snapshot, so it is arguably a variant of the bullet's smooth-projective-variety statement. Even so the status stands on Guo-Zhang-Zhou (genus 1, Fano complete intersections), a clean case; all events are human, unreviewed preprints. Semisimple CohFT case was largely known (Teleman) before the snapshot; the 2025 ancestor/generalized forms may be closer to variants.

corrections.why: F2/F13: the status event (arXiv:2609.01300) proves the Jiang-Tseng orbifold version, arguably a variant of the bullet's smooth-variety statement; partial is still supported by arXiv:2608.29870 (genus-1 case for Fano complete intersections), so the code holds.
